51948.summary: The class explores the character of Barnabas from Acts, emphasizing his role as a servant, encourager, and mentor, highlighting his support for Paul and his approach to ministering to others, while also discussing his occasional weaknesses in handling doctrinal issues.

51949.summary: The class explores the story of Mary and Martha, focusing on their faith and obedience in the face of Lazarus's illness and death. It emphasizes the comfort found in trusting God's timing and will, even when circumstances seem dire.

51950.summary: The class focuses on Mary Magdalene's unwavering commitment to Christ, from her healing to her presence at the cross and resurrection. It emphasizes the importance of following Christ with dedication and perseverance, even through suffering and affliction.
